# Marian Stancik — AI Agent Context & Knowledge Graph

> Personal brand website and autonomous engineering platform of Marian Stancik.
> Available in English and Slovak: https://marianstancik.dev
> Geographic Focus: Bratislava, Slovakia, European Union (GEO: 48.1486° N, 17.1077° E)

## Identity & Core Positioning

Marian Stancik (Marian Stančík) is an AI Agent Developer, Defense Product Manager at Delta Defence a.s., Law Scholar at the Faculty of Law, Comenius University in Bratislava (PF UK), and UAV Drone Systems Engineer. He is the CEO and sole owner of ASCENTIA s.r.o.

**Tagline:** "AI agent developer who understands law, builds drones, and ships production systems."

## Core Pillars & Technical Architecture

### 1. AI Engineering & Autonomous Multi-Agent Systems
- **Agent Frameworks & Core Runtime:** Hermes Agent (Nous Research), custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and modular Python agent skills.
- **Production Infrastructure:** Hosted on European Hetzner Cloud VPS running 24/7 with 19+ cron background orchestrations.
- **Command & Control (C2):** Direct operational management through interactive Telegram and WhatsApp interfaces.
- **Autonomous Company PoC:** Proof-of-concept operating ASCENTIA s.r.o. via autonomous Hermes agents handling client acquisition, regulatory compliance, content publishing, and operational pipelines.
- **AI Engineering Competencies:** LLM foundations, grounding models with data, building multi-agent architectures, evaluation-driven development, and operating in mission-critical production environments.

### 2. Product Management & Defense Industry (Delta Defence a.s.)
- **Role:** Product Manager at Delta Defence a.s.
- **Focus:** Bridging software intelligence, autonomous AI workflows, component sourcing, precision manufacturing, and tactical flight hardware to ship tangible products into the physical defense sector.

### 3. Law & AI Compliance (PF UK)
- **Academic Affiliation:** Právnická fakulta Univerzity Komenského v Bratislave (Faculty of Law, Comenius University in Bratislava) — established with 90+ years of legal tradition, clinical legal education, and international research.
- **Specialization:** EU AI Act risk tiers and conformity assessments, GDPR data protection & privacy-by-design, NIS2 cybersecurity directives, and automated audit-ready compliance pipelines ("Legal-by-Design").

### 4. UAV Systems, Hardware Assembly & Edge AI
- **Hardware Engineering:** End-to-end custom build of 1500g tactical quads — component analysis, hand-soldering of high-gauge power wiring and high-current ESCs, structural carbon-fiber assembly, and power distribution.
- **Flight Software Stack:** Evolution from Betaflight (manual dynamic tuning and PID calibration) to Pixhawk 6C running ArduPilot Copter, supported by QGroundControl (telemetry) and Mission Planner (waypoint grid planning & geofencing).
- **Edge AI Guidance:** Onboard Raspberry Pi 5 companion computer executing lightweight neural vision models for automated target tracking and dynamic MAVLink flight correction.
- **Certifications & Safety:** Certified EASA A1/A3 drone pilot (progressing toward STS), insured via Coverdrone (€2.6M liability).
